name: @agentry/memory
description: Agentry's durable memory MCP — text-as-truth file store + derived node:sqlite/FTS5 index, shipped as a committed zero-install bundle.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:node:sqlite --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
